canonical_project: NH Financial Group Anseong Data Center
notes: inews24 reports the Anseong Fire Department conducted fire-safety field guidance at the NH Financial Group Anseong data center in Gongdo-eup (공도읍), Anseong-si, following the NIRS data center fire, confirming an operating financial-group data center in the county. No public MW figure or opening date found in sources reviewed.
